name: John Ratcliffe
current_role: Director of the Central Intelligence Agency (since January 2025)
summary: John Ratcliffe, a former Texas congressman who was Trump’s director of national intelligence in 2020–2021, has run the CIA since the Senate confirmed him 74–25 on January 23, 2025. Reporting in 2026 described a strained relationship with then-DNI Tulsi Gabbard and Trump leaning on Ratcliffe for intelligence counsel.
